lines.message: <color=#8fd3ff>Shell integrity lost.</color> It's coming apart along both cuts.
lines.author: TACTICAL

lines.message: The amplification is gone. Whatever it was holding, it isn't holding it now.
lines.author: ENGINEERING

lines.message: Two halves, drifting apart. Nothing left to close.
lines.author: TACTICAL

lines.message: That was ours. We built it, and we designed the thing it became.
lines.author: CAPTAIN

lines.message: <color=grey>Atria Control, this is patrol. The site is dark.</color>
lines.author: COMMS

lines.message: Log it and take us home.
lines.author: CAPTAIN
